companyUnderwriting.operatingTrajectory: Q2 2026 revenue $5.463B, +23% YoY; operating profit $2.310B, +48%; TTM operating cash flow $8.667B and company-defined FCF $6.534B.
companyUnderwriting.capitalAllocation: TTM capex $3.312B while $5.819B was returned to owners; U.S. Commerce evidence independently supports large domestic manufacturing expansion and milestone-based incentives.
companyUnderwriting.concentration: Analog remains the dominant segment; industrial, data center and automotive led broad Q2 growth, reducing but not removing cycle/end-market concentration.
keyUnknowns: Current market valuation is not independently source-addressed in this artifact; valuation score is therefore kept in the mixed/unproven band rather than assuming cheapness.
Incremental returns and utilization of the full announced 300mm footprint remain unproven.

thesisQuality.basis: Broad analog/embedded portfolio, strong Q2 growth and cash generation support durable demand/value capture, tempered by semiconductor cyclicality.

financialOperatingMomentum.basis: Q2 revenue +23%, operating profit +48%, TTM operating cash flow $8.667B and FCF $6.534B show strong broad-based recovery and funding capacity.

marketValuationOpportunity.basis: No current source-addressed market valuation was available in the reusable evidence; Methodology requires unknowns to reduce confidence, so valuation is held in mixed/unproven rather than assumed favorable.

catalystScore.basis: Q3 guidance of $5.65-$6.15B revenue plus ongoing 300mm expansion provide identifiable operating/capacity checkpoints, but utilization economics remain uncertain.

governancePower.basis: Strong cash generation alongside disciplined R&D/capex and $5.819B TTM owner returns supports capital-allocation execution, while large fab commitments still require return verification.

alignment2036.basis: Power management, microcontrollers, amplifiers and sensors are foundational across industrial, automotive and data-center physical systems; Commerce independently identifies mature-node production as foundational.

crossDivisionLeverage.basis: Q2 growth was broad across industrial, data center and automotive while analog and embedded processing both grew, showing reusable capability across independent end markets.

bottleneckControl.basis: Large domestic 300mm capacity and foundational mature-node breadth create meaningful supply/cost leverage, but analog supply remains substitutable and utilization is not yet fully proven.

scenarioRobustness.basis: Diversified industrial/data-center/automotive exposure and strong cash generation support multiple demand scenarios; fixed-cost fab expansion remains a downside sensitivity.

substitutionResilience.basis: Broad analog/embedded portfolio and manufacturing scale support qualification and cost advantages, though individual mature-node components have credible substitutes.

supplyChainResilience.basis: Commerce independently supports multi-site U.S. fab expansion in Texas and Utah with milestone-based CHIPS funding; this materially strengthens geographic/capacity resilience.

pricingPower.basis: Operating profit grew 48% on 23% revenue growth and cash conversion strengthened, consistent with favorable operating leverage/value capture, but no explicit contractual pass-through evidence supports a higher band.

riskEvidence.basis: Primary risk is cyclical demand relapse leaving expanded 300mm capacity underutilized; large capital commitments can depress returns despite incentives.

dataConfidenceEvidence.basis: Fresh issuer and SEC operating figures are complemented by independent U.S. government capacity evidence; confidence is reduced by missing source-addressed current valuation and unproven full-fab utilization returns.

scoreRecord.thesis: Texas Instruments combines broad analog/embedded demand, improving cash generation and large domestic 300mm manufacturing scale; durable value depends on converting that capacity into utilization and cost advantage across industrial, automotive and data-center cycles.
scoreRecord.keyRisk: A cyclical demand relapse could leave expanded 300mm capacity underutilized and reduce returns on the large capital program.
scoreRecord.nextCatalyst: Q3 2026 revenue/EPS execution versus $5.65-$6.15B revenue guidance and subsequent evidence of fab utilization/cash conversion.

scoreBreakdown.note: Earth score applies Methodology 1.0 component weights, riskPenaltyWeight 0.16 and confidence floor multiplier policy; rounded conservatively.

Independent U.S. Commerce evidence corroborates substantial domestic fab expansion and policy support.

risks.risk: Fab underutilization if industrial/automotive/data-center demand weakens.

unknowns.unknown: Full announced 300mm footprint utilization and incremental returns.
